articles.title: New DeFi entrant widens field of crypto political campaign funds as elections loom
articles.snippet: The Defend Developers PAC is aiming to contribute to lawmakers who seek to shield crypto developers from legal vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Bitwise model puts bitcoin fair value at $224,000 as sovereign-default hedge
articles.snippet: The figure is from a theoretical model proposed by Greg Foss in 2021 that treats bitcoin as a credit default swap on G20 sovereign bonds.

articles.title: DeFi won't win over big banks until it fixes its hacking problem, executives say
articles.snippet: Lenders are particularly interested in blockchain's back-office applications, but security failures are blocking wider adoption.

articles.title: Banks' survey says people don't want to rock the boat if stablecoin yield risks lending
articles.snippet: The American Bankers Association, which lobbies against the crypto sector over the Clarity Act's stablecoin section, unveiled its new polling.

articles.title: Agentic payment activity tops 100M transactions on Base
articles.snippet: New data suggests AI-driven payment rails are evolving beyond experimentation as users are making more higher-value transfers.
